mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORK_LOG_PLATFORM_INCOME (log_id, platform_id, expected_amount, settlement_status) VALUES (#{logId}, #{platformId}, #{expectedAmount}, #{settlementStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT wpi.income_id, wpi.log_id, wpi.platform_id, wpi.expected_amount, wpi.settlement_status FROM WORK_LOG_PLATFORM_INCOME wpi JOIN WORK_LOG wl ON wpi.log_id = wl.log_id WHERE wl.user_id = #{userId} AND wl.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND wl.work_date IS NOT NULL AND wl.work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT wpi.income_id AS incomeId, wl.user_id AS userId, wpi.platform_id AS platformId, wl.work_date AS workDate, wpi.expected_amount AS expectedAmount, wpi.settlement_status AS settlementStatus FROM WORK_LOG_PLATFORM_INCOME wpi JOIN WORK_LOG wl ON wpi.log_id = wl.log_id WHERE wl.user_id = #{userId} AND wl.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND wl.work_date IS NOT NULL AND wl.work_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY wl.work_date, wpi.platform_id, wpi.income_id
